quote: The growth rate of marimo is about 5 mm (0.2 in) per year.

text: V japonském jezeře Akan dorůstá až 20–30 cm.
quote: In Lake Akan in Japan they grow particularly large, up to 20–30 cm (8–12 in).

text: Kulovitý tvar udržují mírné vlny, které kuličky občas otočí.
quote: The round shape of the marimo is maintained by gentle wave action that occasionally turns it.

text: Preferuje jezera s nízkou či střední biologickou aktivitou a vyšším obsahem vápníku.
quote: Marimo's preferred habitat is in lakes with a low or moderate biological activity, and with moderate or high levels of calcium.

text: Z jezer mizí kvůli nadbytku živin ze zemědělství a chovu ryb.
quote: An excess of nutrients (due to agriculture and fish farming), along with mud deposition from human activity are thought to be the main causes for its disappearance from many lakes.
